title: Great night!
text: We had an amazing tour with Sophie.  She was very knowledgeable. Got to learn a lot about the Gothic area as well as she picked an amazing tapas bar and recommended some amazing dishes.  And now we’re at the Flamenco 💃 performance.  Great night in Barcelona.
author: 700heathers

title: Outstanding
text: Great job by Cam. So knowledgeable and kind. We experienced and saw buildings we would never have know about.
author: Evelyn_J

title: Recommend
text: We loved Carlos.  He was very personable 10/10 recommend him. .   Would say that the flamenco show wasn’t awesome.
author: Melissa_b

title: Do this tour if you’re in Barcelona
text: We were pleasantly surprised at how interesting the Gothic area was, Feliciano was very informative and kept it fun at the same time. He did a great job ordering a tasty variety of tapas to eat for dinner. So glad we did the tour to get a chance to experience the sights and sounds of the Born district, Born is derived from jousting! Another fact we learned! Great job Feliciano!!
author: Mark_A

title: Flamingo show
text: Tour guide was fantastic.  Restaurant was fantastic, flamingo dancing was not very enjoyable.  It seems all they did was chant and bang their feet on the floor.  People with kids had to leave because the kids were scared.
author: BettyJo_C

title: Great tour of the Gothic Area with an incredible guide
text: Our tour group had a guide and two couples allowing us to cover a lot of ground and get a thorough appreciation of the Gothic area.  The tour guide organized a tapas dinner at a non-tourist trap venue.  Great food and conversations.  The evening ended with a Flamenco show.  One of the best tours I've taken.
author: joseph_p

title: Excellent tour in Gothic barcelonia
text:
Xavier was a charming knowledgeable guide who gave interesting details on our 1.5 hour walk through the Gothic district. 
Stopping for Tapas and wine was a delight! Flamingo show was fun
author: Elizabeth_D

title: The tour, food and dancing was a complete capture of the culture and rich history this area has and had to offer.
text: The history related to us by the guide and information about the area, buildings, streets, the people that lived in the area and shops were amazing. Far exceeded my expectations.
author: K6851UZkeithr

title: A great time!
text: The Tour was excellent and the guide was great. The Tapas dinner was perfect   We loved the show as well.
author: Susan_G

title: Excellent guide, excellent food, excellent show!
text: There were only 4 in our group, so it turned out to be almost a private tour!  Feliciano was an excellent guide and my husband and I thoroughly enjoyed listening to him as he explained the history of all the sites we saw along the way. It was obvious that he loves and is very passionate about his city and culture, and we could not have asked for a better tour guide. Everything we tried during the tapas dinner was delicious, and the Flamenco show was amazing!! We didn't want it to end! We would highly recommend this tour.
author: Q312CUlindam
